## How it was checked

- [ ] `pytest` passes
- [ ] `black`, `isort`, `flake8` and `ruff check` pass (or `pre-commit run --all-files`)
- [ ] A test covers the change (a regression test for a bug fix)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` for anything a user would notice
- [ ] No large binary files added (GIFs, videos): link them or keep them under 1 MB
